newsitem.title: ITALY: Europe car sales seen down 3.2 pct in March - ANFIA.
newsitem.headline: Europe car sales seen down 3.2 pct in March - ANFIA.

text.p: Overall European car sales in March totalled 1,228,900 units, a fall of 3.2 percent on the same month in 1996, provisional data from Italian carmakers' association Anfia showed.

Anfia said in a statement that the good performance of the Italian market, with new registrations up 25 percent in March, had helped to limit the decline. Excluding Italy, the fall would have been 7.7 percent.
In the first three months of this year, Anfia said deliveries in Europe totalled 3,392,800 units, down 2.4 percent.
In March, the French market saw a 20.9 percent slump, German sales fell 9.3 percent and in Britain they slipped 0.8 percent. But the Spanish market grew 1.9 percent.
Cumulative sales for the first quarter showed a 25.5 percent fall in France and a six percent decline in Germany. But the British market rose 3.2 percent and Spain six percent.
